scope: Offline HTML diagnostics for the current local Windows VS Code window.

checks: Near-15-MiB journal history renders offline with PID reuse, gaps, partial coverage and escaped text.
Process selection, threshold visibility, pointer readout and event pagination work.
Desktop and narrow layouts are captured without horizontal overflow.
Empty history stays readable; no remote request, script error or CSP error was observed.

limits: Report export reads only the current window log session, with a 15-MiB disk budget.
Historical per-process coverage is bounded to the retained top 20 plus any separate Editor Services sample.
